journey.heading: Timeless Journey of Crafting Excellence in Ship Repair
journey.paragraph1: We believe ship repair is more than tasks performed on a vessel — it's about building lasting partnerships that inspire trust and ensure seaworthiness. Our skilled team brings expertise and a passion for excellence to every project.
journey.paragraph2: From aluminum and steel plate works to piping and industrial applications, we cover the full spectrum of modern ship repair with consistency, precision, and respect for our clients' schedules.

slide1.heading: Starting with a Vision and a Love for the Sea
slide1.paragraph: Navergo began as a small workshop in the port of Perama, dedicated to ship repair and deeply aware of the needs of crews who entrust their vessels to our hands.

slide2.heading: Building Relationships with Fleets and Owners
slide2.paragraph: With the expansion of our steel plate department, we took on larger hull restoration and frame reinforcement projects, establishing Navergo as a reliable partner for Greek and international shipping offices.

slide3.heading: Shaping the Future of Ship Repair
slide3.paragraph: We invested in modern aluminum welding equipment and specialized staff to support complex superstructures, cabins, and critical vessel sections with the precision class societies demand.

slide4.heading: Innovating Ship Repair, Enriching Voyages
slide4.paragraph: ISO 9001 certification sealed our commitment to quality. Our processes were standardized, enabling predictable timelines and transparent communication at every phase of the project.

slide5.heading: Your Partner in Modern Ship Repair Solutions
slide5.paragraph: We expanded into engine-room piping works, cooling systems, and fuel management, offering integrated support to crews and technical managers of vessels.

slide6.heading: Enriching Ship Repair with Consistency and Respect
slide6.paragraph: With dozens of completed projects each year, Navergo became one of the most trusted names in Perama ship repair, with clients across the Mediterranean and Northern Europe.

slide7.heading: Your Partner in Modern Ship Repair Solutions
slide7.paragraph: We upgraded our workshops and added advanced measurement and inspection tools, aiming for zero deviation from specifications and maximum safety during dry-dock operations.

slide8.heading: Navergo — Elevating Standards in Ship Repair
slide8.paragraph: Today Navergo combines decades of experience with modern practices, highly specialized engineers, and a workshop crew that respects every delivery deadline without compromising on quality.

q1.question: What ship repair services does your company offer?
q1.answer: Navergo offers comprehensive ship repair services including aluminum works, steel plate works, engine-room piping, consulting services, and industrial applications. We cover the full spectrum of vessel repair, maintenance, and upgrade work in the port of Perama.

q2.question: How do you ensure the quality of your work?
q2.answer: Navergo is ISO 9001 certified and follows the standards of major international class societies. We perform quality checks at every phase, work closely with class surveyors, and use modern measurement equipment to ensure zero deviation from specifications.

q3.question: What is the typical timeline for completing a project?
q3.answer: Timelines depend on the scope of the project. Small repairs can be completed in a few days, while larger hull or engine-room overhauls may take several weeks. We plan every project precisely to minimize dry-dock time.

q4.question: Can you help with class approvals and certificates?
q4.answer: Yes. We coordinate directly with class society surveyors (Lloyd's Register, ABS, DNV, Bureau Veritas, etc.) and prepare all technical documentation required for approvals and certificate renewals.

q5.question: How do you ensure the project stays within budget?
q5.answer: We provide a detailed quotation before work begins, with transparent costing for materials and labor. We track progress closely and notify the owner immediately about any proposed additional work, so there are no surprises.

member.name: Johnathan Carter
member.bio1: Johnathan Carter is a seasoned Lead Engineer with over 12 years of experience in the ship repair industry. He specializes in structural engineering, project planning, and shipyard management, ensuring that every project meets the highest standards of safety and efficiency.
member.bio2: With a strong background in naval engineering, Johnathan has successfully led numerous tanker, commercial, and passenger vessel repair projects from conception to completion. His expertise in modern ship repair techniques, material selection, and sustainability allows him to deliver innovative solutions tailored to each project's unique requirements.

teamDetails.blockquote: "As a key member of our team, Johnathan is committed to quality craftsmanship, on-time delivery, and cost-effective execution, making him an invaluable asset in driving our projects to success."
